sources.title: ProductionCrate homepage (nav/footer only, pricing page not reachable via static fetch)

limits.en: Free 'Sample' tier with limited access to VFX, sound, graphics and 3D assets; full-resolution/unwatermarked downloads require a paid plan.

keyLimits.en: Limited/sample access to VFX, sound, graphics and 3D assets; no full-resolution or unwatermarked downloads.

cautions.en: Exact paid plan prices could not be confirmed: the pricing/upgrade pages are dynamic (JavaScript-rendered) and returned only navigation content when fetched; third-party trackers mention figures around $19-49/month for Pro tiers but these are not independently verified against the official page.

capabilities.en: Stock library of VFX elements, sound effects/music, motion graphics and 3D models for video production.
Separate sub-brand sites (e.g. SoundCrate, GraphicsCrate, RenderCrate) organized by asset category.

limitations.en: Free tier assets are limited/sample-only; full commercial-use downloads require a paid subscription.
Pricing structure and plan tiers are not transparently documented on a static, easily-crawlable page, making self-service comparison harder.

missingAlternatives.name: Storyblocks
missingAlternatives.reason: Well-known stock VFX/footage/asset subscription competitor already present in the seed's alternativeCandidates list for this tool, suggesting it should exist as a full catalogue entry.

unknowns: Exact paid plan names, prices and per-plan limits for ProductionCrate could not be verified from the official site in this session; the pricing pages did not return usable content via automated fetch (dynamic/JS-rendered), and the budget (max 8 pages) was reached without finding a static pricing table.
No alternativeCandidates in the seed matched ProductionCrate's actual category (stock VFX/asset libraries) precisely, so no in-catalogue alternatives were listed with confidence.
